levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Uses a judgment word instead of one of the five neutral signal words.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both entries use one of the five neutral words correctly.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Both entries use a neutral word and the clue clearly supports it.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Entry rates the signal as good or bad, or avoids describing a mix-up.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Entry is neutral and, if a mix-up happened, describes it factually.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Entry is neutral and the reflection names specifically what made the mix-up happen.

lookFors: No weight, size, or calorie language appears anywhere.
Two distinct moments are recorded, not one moment written twice.
Clue described is a physical sensation, not a general statement.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
